body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> CES found its new identity as a "Global Event" on their 40th anniversary year in Las Vegas.

This year''s CES theme was "Contents, Technology and Everything In Between". This was evidenced by the various companies exhibited at the CES this year. There were not only hardware companies at the show, but also numerous software and service companies presented their newest products to the world. Software companies such as eBay or Skype even filled the advertising spaces that were previously bombarded by hardware companies’ advertisements.

The president of CEA, Gary Shapiro, told Aving at a mini interview yesterday that CES is not a trade show anymore, but it is one of the most important global events, where visionaries, experts and leaders of the IT industry gather together on one place.

The theme is apparent in global brands’ product strategies. Samsung announced the strategic alliance with Google. Motorola presented a cell phone that is based on Yahoo!’s “Go service”. Panasonic set up the ‘Panasonic Concierge’ to emphasize on the after service aspects of the business along with its hardware products.
